links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to blepharoplasty questions
links.effect: All responses required advanced reading skills at a 'college graduate' level or higher, with Copilot's responses being the most complex.
links.quote: Readability analyses revealed that all responses required advanced reading skills at a 'college graduate' level or higher, with Copilot's responses being the most complex.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, clinical relevance, and readability of four commercial LLMs responding to upper eyelid blepharoplasty questions using expert ratings and standard readability metrics.
